items.description: The Drop!in v1.2.3 Mashup helps users locate events that are taking place within the proximity of their locations. The application detects and lists corporate events, social activities, or fun destinations where individuals can visit to engage in past time or work-related activities.
Zvents allows users to discover events by location and type. For active event locations, Zvents leverages the Active.com API.
Gatekrash Mobile is a touchscreen-optimised version of Gatekrash, providing event listings for the UK. It uses the Gatekrash API to request relevant data.
Integration allows MailChimp users to import Eventbrite events and send invitations
Connect your event's Twitter account to Tweetbrite and it will automatically tweet new registrations for your event.
A map of all events around a point in France, Belgium and Switzerland.

Discover upcoming events and stuff to do in a nice and simple interface based on Google Maps. Search for events, narrow down with category, place or date and sort your search by relevance, date, title, popularity or venue name. Mapping Events is powered by Eventful API, Google Maps API, Google AJAX Search API, WorldIP API, Yahoo YQL and Yahoo YUI.
Dynamic map of the Active.com database showing sports related activities such as running events, tennis tournaments, triathlons and highschool sports by location.
Mashup to get nformation about your local events. Uses Eventful and Google Maps.
A visualization of events. Bubbles featuring the most popular art and design events in New York City. Built using the Art Beat API.
Bubbles featuring the most popular art and design events in Tokyo. Built using the ArtBeat API.
GirlFriend X is a web-based little Black Book 2.0 for single guys.
Post and share events for free. Get local event information on your cell phone. Post and share invites. Uses the Eventful API.

Mashup of Google Maps, Virtual Earth with many other APIs. Ext.js is used to make user interface intuitive. It lets you search for hotels, photos, restaurants, wifi spots, local news/blogs, events, weather, and many other spatial data.
Community networking site that allows members to get in touch with their neighbours. The site uses APIs from Nestoria, flickr, Eventful and more to provide local information to users.
Slick podcast app that combines band event data from Eventful with MP3 tracks. Type in a city, get MP3s, discover a band you like, and go see them.
The EVDB (now Eventful) API combined with MS MapPoint creates a mini-map (Feedmap) showing bloggers and events nearby a particular blogger.
Mashup of EVDB event data and Google Maps, with nice calendar browser for paging through search results.

A useful mashup combining an ADSL availability checker with Google maps. Type in a UK postcode and a map is displayed showing the distance from that post code to the local telephone exchange. This distance is then used to calculate the maximum speed.
Share your location in real-time using Mologogo. A free service that will track your friends GPS-enabled cell phones from another phone or on the web. With various social networking features.
CashFly is a cash point (ATM) locator for the UK. The site is integrated with Google Maps and calculates cash points nearest to you using your current latitude and longitude.
Connected to Us creates a communication system using the hardware your team members and customers already own.
Doculib.org is a free pdf file sharing site using Bing Search Api.
GrabEvery is shopping price comparison site with a coupons and coupon codes. Several millions of products from thousands of stores on one place.
An artist-based radio, with information and photos about the currently playing artist. Pulls data from Last.fm and YouTube.
A Google Maps mashup that allows you to calculate the per-passenger greenhouse gas emissions created by a commercial airline flight between any two airports.
Local Daily Deals sourced by 8coupons.
A directory that details a range of useful information and locations such as car parks, cash machines, recycling banks, post offices, emergency contacts plus much more in the city of Lincoln, UK.
Meteo Malineo is a web application that provides free weather forecast for France, over 10,000 cities. The application uses Open Weather Map API.
An integration that allows users to send files from their Box.net accounts directly into ConceptShare, where other users can discuss them and offer feedback in a real-time setting.

Searoutefinder is a tool for measuring distances between ports located all over the world and for visualizing them on a Google Map. It doesn't just visualize, but calculates the freighter ship's estimated fual consumption and the estimated duration of the journey.
Branded Red Letter Days affiliate site for SEO and PPC. Uses Red Letter Days feed and Google Maps API to map gift experiences by UK locations.
ShopAbout.co.uk is a comparison shopping site based on the Shopping.com API. Search and shop items by category.
Geo presents various information from the World Bank, including projects, data, news, and center location.
One Hit Wonders from Forbes, Wikipedia and American Idol are mapped. Also includes videos from YouTube for many entries.
Combines YouTube videos, Flickr photos, Last.fm albums and Amazon books, grouped by Wikipedia category.
This mashup allows Box.net users to send documents in their Box accounts as snail mail using PostalMethods.
Create sets of media related to fashion, particularly leaning towards coverage of fashion events, and share them with other members.
This mashup allows Box.net users to edit files within their Box accounts using Zoho, then save the edited files directly back to Box.
allSongsBy provides full song listings for any artist via YouTube's vast free music collection. Lists are organized by artist and album.

Rebate Bus makes utility energy efficiency incentives easy. It hooks into eCommerce and distributor websites to integrate the incentives into the purchase experience. Rebate Bus is a utility rebate expert. They can file applications on your behalf, deliver instant incentives on your website and give you access to their rebate API
This mashup plots US Environmental Protection Agency data on a Google Map. Ability to search by location.
TweetValue helps you appraise your Twitter account with a dollar value. Now when you’re ready to sell, you’ll know what to charge.
Get random images from a Flickr group of your choosing. Good for use in other mashups, websites or just for browsing. Mashup using Google App Engine and Flickr.
Mashup of Joomla, Amazon eCommerce, and NY Times Best Sellers.
RideDog aims to help cyclists find and map the best road rides, mountain bike trails and cyclocross rides. Useful for discovering new routes in your own communities or while traveling.
UK site with Google Maps to help find dine-in and takeaway food. Menus and readers reviews online to peruse.
Dutch National Heritage List in the Netherlands (rijksmonumenten). Many Dutch tourist attractions are rijksmonuments, such as castles or windmills. There are 61.000 rijksmonuments in the Netherlands.
Find Meetup groups in your area based on topic keyword and current geographic location.
Dutch mashup that superimposes carnival parade routes on a Virtual Earth map.
Panoramic virtual tours presenting historical objects, landscapes, urban areas, hotels, restaurants, entertainment and sport centers etc. In Czech and English.
Indeed job search integrated with Facebook and LinkedIn - find jobs close to friends, and see who you know (or contacts know) at those offering the job.
TodoToday Pro for Cohuman is a todo list application to show current due and overdue tasks from the online task management tool Cohuman.com.
A Wordpress plugin that pushes updates to Taglets.org when you publish a post.
The Weekend Warrior Hike Finder for Los Angeles and surrounding areas. Warning, can load slowly.
Shows the location of safari camps and lodges in Botswana's Okavango Delta, with recent traveler reviews, photos and short descriptions. You can also add this map to your own site or blog.
NewsShare leverages Twitter to provide up-to-date news. Enter keywords for tracking news. Listen to news.

Sumoradio combines various radio station playlists with Amazon.com. If you heard a song on the radio you can jump online, Sumo knows who, what and when. All playlists are updated every 5 minutes, you can save tracks for later by clicking Add to my mix.

SnapsBoard help to preserve photos and videos in the original resolution. The mashup's principle: never lose a photo, is related to privacy, personalization, and categorization found in the app. While organizing digital images could be important for some members, others prefer to print images from a smart phone. That's why SnapsBoard offers a Walgreen's printing service connected to the phone.
The Audience Finder tool lets you find Facebook users that should be part of a custom audience for your Facebook advertising campaigns.
Create online video mixtapes to share with friends. Search for artists or songs on YouTube. Drag results into your list to create your own mixtape.
TextOrder.net provides a complete solution for text message ordering. Promote specials, new items, news, etc. and use as a word of mouth marketing tool.

ActionSprout is a web application that can be integrated into Facebook. ActionSprout enables Facebook users to share events and/or sign petitions right on their Facebook page. ActionSprout enables its customers to connect with and find support from others through Facebook directly.
Maps popular Vancouver British Columbia attractions with links to more information.
Google map mashup of the services that are open 24-hours in major US cities. Currently covers Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York City. Currently over 2400 locations.

Lets you use any phone to catch up on the most popular topics on Twitter, even when you can't get online. Without signing up, you can call Howdy to hear the top 10 current trends, with an explanation of each.
Free UK Postcode maps using the latest Royal Mail and Ordnance Survey Postcode information with Google Maps.
Hulimail notifies you the instant someone important to you joins your mailing list.

CarePages.com allows members to move the content contained on a site including message board comments, updates regarding care and prognosis and photographs into a CarePages Keepsake Book that can be purchased immediately or personalized further.
Outlet Note is a great place to find information about outlet stores in the United States. Google Maps (including Directions and Street View) are used to help you better locate a outlet store.
Add My Pet Profile from MatchMyPet.com to your iGoogle page.
Tv Foodies helps you find the tv shows you see on channels like the Travel Channel, Food Network etc.
Where were you during significant moments in history? Share your story.

A submission to the Australian Government's Mashup Australia incentive. This mashup uses Victorian schools, emergency services, and 2006 Australian Census data to visualise what a school and its area might be like.
Loku is an application that displays local neighborhood maps and lets users explore what is happening nearby. It displays news stories and videos, events and deals.
Preview what everyone is bookmarking in del.icio.us. With this Google gadget, you can preview, add tabs, and remove tabs for the tags in the Tagcloud.
Access to all of your local Groupon deals, even the ones that don't reach your mailbox. Find out about deals in other cities that you can participate in. Uses Groupon API and offers email support.

Use Google Maps interface to search for images of the China Brazil Earth Resources Satellites (CBERS 2 and 2b). The images cover all South America. Images are a free download to any computer in Brazil.
FakeGirlfriend.co allows single guys to appear that they have a girlfriend when they actually don't. You can text the app and your fake girlfriend will text you and then call you back.

A map mashup for the Gold Coast of Queensland Australia, showing accommodation and attractions. Simple application using custom icons, single xml file, selectable grouping. Aims are to build the map content via user submission to the forum on the site.
German movie portal. Uses APIs from YouTube, Google Maps and Amazon.
Beanvest is an investment portfolio tracking application. It allows you to keep track of all your investments in one place with helpful insights.
Bestseller list for Germany's Amazon.de.
Provides an alert via Twitter when new schools in your interest area have needs. The DC stands for DonorsChoose, a platform for aggregating non-profit needs.

A guide for Red Sox fans visiting Ft Myers, Florida for spring training. Created with the Atlas mapping tool. Fans can plot photos on a satellite image of City of Palms Park and comment on businesses found via Google Local Search.

See all the text links to images in one window without scrolling or clicking. Heres an example, you are on reddit and there is a thread about movie posters. Multiple people have posted multiple images in the thread. TikiPik scrapes the page, finds all those links and give you a preview of them in a pop up. From there you can click any link and see it 100% in a new tab.
A mashup site where you can leave your digital footprints that are of emotional value to you. You can post photos and videos by form upload, email or MMS.

SaveUp is a top Polish e-commerce mobile app. It allows to recognize the movies, books, games or audio CDs covers. Identified items can be puchased instantly in one of the 50 biggest online shops in the country. Appllication provides to its users more than 3 000 000 offers.
Nice integration of library data like what you have checked-out or are waiting forinto an automatically updating Google Gadget. Initially for Ann Arbor District Library. Talis mashup contest winner.
Draws Notices to Airmen and Temporary Flight Restrictions using Google Map API

This is an interactive music video for the indie rock group Arcade Fire. It places users in the video by using the google maps api to simulate the neighborhood they grew up in. An animated runner is rendered using html5 over streetview and air photo maps.
Mashup that helps you discover and share GPS tracks and waypoints on the web quickly and easily.
A Google Maps and Hellenic National Tourist Organization mashup with information about mountain refuges in Greece. With links to tourist site details.
Pray In Time provides most accurate and reliable timetable of Athan time for millions of inhabited and uninhabited locations globally.
Monitor top selling video games by console using Amazon sales data. Add lists to your iGoogle home page.

Mashing up Twilio and Freshbooks to make time tracking easier. You call into a Twilio phone number, and it asks you which client you want to begin billing. When you're all done with your work, you call back and clock out. Your hours are then submitted directly to your FreshBooks account, including a transcription of an optional voice note.
View the club teams for players on each of the national team rosters in this summers tournament.

A prediction market for Amazon products. Each new product added becomes a stock. If a product's Amazon's sales rank improves, its stock price goes up. And vice-versa. Traders buy, sell, short, and cover.

Helps users find RSS feeds and autogenerates OPML files. Uses Windows Live Search API. Facilitates selecting feeds from root weblogs or comments feeds per user selection with support for international markets.
Perfect Background Check provides the most complete online criminal background check on anyone you know with over 500 million criminal records.
Surf predictions and forecasts for surfing spots across the globe. Use the Google Maps interface to get a surf forecast for a coastal prediction.
Image search in the 2 million royalty free images in photo bank Fotolia. Also use it to create instant e-cards.
An online language-learning site providing tutoring and coaching for Arabic, French, and Spanish.
Calls you when you've lost your phone, and lets you record a public message telling everyone where you found it.

Access your personal phone book from any phone with a simple phone call or from a computer. A lost, stolen, uncharged or damaged cell phone doesn't mean you've lost access to your contacts. As a Bevoz member you have backup access from any phone worldwide. Simply dial the Bevoz access number and use your personalized secure PIN to access your account contacts.
Top Business Schools in US as reported in US News and World Report: GMAT Score, Avg Tuition, Avg Salary.
Developed for the New York Fashion Now exhibition at the Victoria & Albert Museum in London, this mashup allows people to upload their hints, tips, and stories about New York.
One Stop Cottage, the Holiday Cottage Search Engine, is a very fast way to find your UK holiday cottage. It quickly searches over 40,000 cottages from 35 companies.
Very good, up-to-date gas price search with Google Maps station display.
Recent school shootings mapped. Compiled from infoplease.com
New year's greetings using the Flickr API.
Dual maps let you display two maps side-by-side for a single location. Use the dual map to combine the features of Google Maps and Microsoft Virtual Earth Maps within one embeddable control.

TaggedBack.com is a free service where you register and then catalog your belongings. It allows for a simple way to keep track of the things that you own. If you lose an item that you have tagged, the person who finds it will see the tag, prompting them to go to the TaggeBack.com website. Upon entering your tag number, they will be able to notify you immediately via email and text message if you verified your phone number. The person who found your item never sees your email address unless you choose to reply to them.
An online flirtation site that lets you anonymously send pre-defined sms messages to people you know and check the read status.

Twitter account management tool that lets you maintain an active list of friends and followers, and find interesting people over Twitter. Uses the three step Flush - Grow - Reciprocate features to manage your account.
Always updated geo-targeted web programming jobs. Neatly organized data from Indeed.com.
Application and map for business card sharing.
A simon game for telephone using DTMF tones.
Ibiza and Google Maps designed for the iPhone.
An online diary for Twitter users. It's totally free. Track and rate your Moo'd Tweets...
Google News Bar gadget (based on Google AJAX search API) can be added to your Google home page. Add the search terms of your interest and view them as vertical or horizontal newsbars.
Click on two points on the NYC Google Map and the program will display the shortest subway route between those two points, including walking time.
Reskin your iGoogle page and share your skins with others by submitting to the directory.
This web designer directory adds a Google maps mashup to locate your local designer or programmer listed in the smallbiz3000.com directory.
Well... is it?
Washington DC city and transit guide Google Maps mashup. Metro Links also combines blog postings from Window Shopper, Free Ride and Top Stops.
A real estate mashup featuring homes on the California central coast.
This is a tool to allow you to convert HTML to images. It is built based on the page2image API.
Maps local kite surfing, landboarding and snow kiting spots aroung the world. Map markers color coded based on current wind condtions. Includes 6-day wind/temp/snow forecast for 1,500 kiting spots.
Downloads Shopify store data directly into Microsoft Excel.

DPhotoIndex is a website that aims to provide information with sample photos taken with certain cameras and lenses. Brief reviews of cameras and lenses are accompanied by series of photos retrieved from Flickr. This way, the visitor is able to see real examples of the capability and functionality of particular cameras and lenses.

DBpedia Mobile maps DBpedia locations and allows users to explore background information about them by navigating into DBpedia and other interlinked datasets such as GeoNames, Revyu, EuroStat and Flickr. Supports 14 languages and various filters.
Habitamos Maps combines postings from Habitamos with Google Maps satellite pictures to show a houses and apartments for sale or to rent (Spain). Warning: slow from US.
Online running log service with local search and sharing using Google maps. Running log has nice graphing features.
Flash-based interface to Google Talk. Allows you to chat without a client install. Gtalkr also has its own API.

This real-time vehicle tracker takes position reports sent a server and plots them as pushpins. The map refreshes at about the same interval as the position reports coming in. Right-click two pushpins and get some distance, speed, and time info.
A continuous stream of videos from YouTube by (or related to) the rock band, The Decemberists.
This Google Maps transit mashup takes an independent ride-guide for the San Diego Trolley and mashes it up with Google Maps.
A simple mashup showing interesting Flickr photos.
Use this bookmarklet to view a Twitter user's trstrank in your browser.

This is the 3rd in the moveable series, that started with Moveable Weather, and then moved on to Moveable Tides. This time, this Tropo/Google Latitude/Wikipedia mashup reads to from Wikipedia pages about places registered on the National Registry of Historic Places. (U.S only). You can surf virtually, or actually visit the locations with your GPS-enabled phone.

This is a mash-up of data from the OpenDOAR directory of Open Access Repositories with Google Maps and repository growth charts from ROAR, Registory of Open Access Repositories, developed by Stuart Lewis of the University of Aberystwyth, Wales.
hasLockers is a cloud service for content locking based on hasOffers API.
Demo service from Pho.to for creating animated gif avatars or static avatars for free. You can adopt the same functionality on your site using the pho.to API.
Comparison shopping service with prices from many online merchants. Uses the Shopping.com API.
Create your tweets and post them at any future date and time.

Want to know how to build an anonymous chat service like ChatRoulette? Check this tutorial on how to build such an app! The tutorial is organised in the form of a rage comic, which conveys emotions in a universally understood manner. :-)
A geo-broadcasting platform for users to broadcast and experience destinations around the world. Seero combines live and on-demand video with GPS mapping.
A mashup app at uses Grazr to interact with Rhapsody, making for a smoother experience than the Rhapsody default UI. You will need a Rhapsody account to stream any audio.

Hotel mashups of Google Map, more then 30.000 hotels to locate on the map. View hotels on the map with Panoramic street view of the location where available. APIs used Hotel Club, Google Maps and Street Cities.
Comprehensive mashup for real-time UK traffic information.

Venmo makes settling up with friends easy and social. It works with just about any phone or through the web. It's completely free to use with your friends, so you can always skip the ATM when you need to settle up on things like meals, rent, bills, drinks, group trips and bingo.

Birdsearch enables users to super their search on Twitter. Search tool on twitter is a gold mine for surfacing the most ¥aluable tweets, whether it's the top tweets, most engaged tweets, viral tweets, tweets from specific users, media, news etc, it makes it easier to separate the signal substance from the noise. However, Twitter search has been stagnant for many years in terms of refining the search, the UX and one cannot construct their own advanced search queries on mobile, which is where Bird search comes in.
Uses PHP and xslt to transform RSS feeds from Flickr into thumbnailed HTML pages. See demo and download code to run it on your own site.

With Showrooms you are able to playfully present your products as interactive shop app. It's an HTML5 based video application that imports all required product information via the Goole Shopping API. Site is in German.
A Google Maps mashup showing photos from www.zyeuter.com
Zendesk for voice. Talkdesk is a powerful voice customer support system. Answer customer support calls in the browser.
A mobile widget that uses the Google Translate API to convert across 10 different languages from any Nokia S60 series phone. Works with English, Chinese, Italian, French, German and others.
A SoundCloud user browser that displays relations and connections between users. Will also play their most popular track. It's a ActionScript 3.0 project with source code available.
A music mashup of Lastfm, Musicbrainz, Lyricsfly, Youtube and Google Maps.
Multiple ways to browse random images from Flickr: all, interestingness, photostreams, groups, etc.

Manage and track business expenses and receipts *View credit card transactions and add them to expense reports *Capture receipts with your camera phone *Submit and approve expense reports (approve invoices too!) Manage and track business travel *Book airfare, hotels and more *Manage flight, hotel and car itineraries *Check flight status *Approve travel requests *Change/cancel reservations

This We Know lets you get local and explore government data about your community. Enter your city or zip code and get a list of facts. Click an individual item and be taken to a breakdown of the data. Finalist in Apps for America 2 contest.
Find ethnic restaurants in your neighborhood.

IndiaTweetz- Tweets and News about India- is a one stop Twitter based portal to tap the buzz in India.Tweets are categorized in groups like Headlines,Cricket,Politics,Business, Bollywood,Celebrities,Cities etc.
When on the move, get the 5 closest points of interest of a brand or category like Starbucks, Bank, Sephora, Museums, scattered all around Paris. More than 5000 POI are available.
Local search of places close to the subway stations in Sao Paulo, Brazil.

Displays the current world ocean forecast data using Google Maps to quickly navigate around the world to locate your required coastal region. Data includes wave height, direction, period and wind strength and direction.
As you type a location, Google Maps Instant centers a map on the best result that is returned from Google's geocoder. The tool is surprisingly good at determining cities based on partial input.
PhoneTap lets you record your outgoing phone calls, giving you a record of who you talked to and what was said. Plays both parties a notice that the call is recorded at the start of each call.
Create, save and share personal customizable Google maps. Easy to share links to sites, or embed map in web page. RSS feed for newly published maps.

Caret is automatable status sharing triggered by your device's sensors (context aware status sharing). With Caret you are able to Personalize presence info with automated context & interactive B2C/B2B services. With the Caret App you can: Assign real time statuses to phone numbers for sharing with contacts See when & why contacts are available or busy Manage what contacts see about you Call & end-to-end encrypted status based messaging for free Create custom statuses to meet your business needs Discover your contacts' interests in real time The app is available for free for iOS, Anrdoid, and Amazon devices.
Popup Chinese allows people to get feedback on their chinese pronunciation by recording a message that will then be listened to by teachers in China during their business hours.
Uses the yolink search API to return expanded keyword search information from the government’s PubMed medical database, allowing quick review for relevant information.
Classified listing service for boat slips and marinas. Uses Google Maps API for precise mapping and geosearching.

ShoesNBags is the first, native iPhone app for Zappos catalog searching. It is easy to use and allows users to browse, search and buy products from Zappos.com. It works on all iOS devices and it requires Internet connectivity.

Environmental information in your iPhone, iPod Touch and iPad iEnviroWatch allows to visualize and query environmental information at your location or geographical area of your interest. *Basic Features: - Environmental information services published by the European Environment Agency - Base maps provided by ESRI, the worldwide leader in - GIS - Street Map - Satellite Imagery - Topographic Map - GPS capability - Intuitive user interface
TweetTest is a collection of six mini games that use data from your and your friend’s public Tweets.
Funtimeplanner helps users plan trips by providing information on the top events and venues across the UK.
Thanks to PayPal, users can donate money to help friends in times of need.
Mashup satellite images from BBC Weather and t7online. See the Instructions tab to see how to do it.
Gramfeed is an Instagram web client.
Take payments over the phone using stripe.com
Google map of the journey of Abass Hassans from Somalia Refugee Camps in Kenya to Princeton University.
This mashup combines great motorcycling routes on a map along with route information, trip length, and locations of nearest H-D dealerships and Best Western Hotels.
Turkey's first Google Maps powered real estate marketplace. Includes real estate search.
Spying on FriendFeed public timeline in real time and more.
Enabling record labels to offer previews to artist fan clubs months in advance of releases, driving up pre-sales.

hearSay lets you make recorded phone calls from an anonymous number using only your web browser. hearSay uses Twilio Client to connect the user to any US number, then emails the user a recording of the call automatically. No sign up or login required.
Amazon and Twitter mashup to watch prices and availability.

Tries to simulate the simple joys of talking over CB radio on the highway. Just call in and enter the number of a highway and you will be entered into a group chat with other people traveling along the same road.
The history of professional and major league sports teams in a Google Gadget. Each day of the year features a professional sports team from the past or present.

Vizoor is a stunning and fast visual Internet Search engine, it uses the latest web search API from Bing (Microsoft). It shows results in a beautiful 3D perspective format , it is developed using Silverlight and asp.net technologies.

Raise the Money is an online company that provides an application that allows political candidates and committees to accept donations/contributions on their websites. Raise the Money is a platform that connects political candidates with their supporters from around the web.
This service pulls project details from either Google Code, or GitHub.
A free online mileage log using Google Maps API to calculate distance traveled. UK-focused.
Search for commercial properties that are for sale across the United States.

Phone2Action is a digital grassroots platform that attracts and engages supporters from around the web. It provides political campaigns with tools such as social media, calling, and email advocacy to help connect political candidates with their supporters.
